posts.description:
Even after-tax season, we make it easy to walk-in and get help.
Even after the season ends, our experts are here to support you. Let Liberty Tax help you tie up any loose ends so you can move forward with peace of mind.
Happy 4th of July from Liberty Tax!!

Homeownership comes with tax benefits! Liberty Tax is here to help you navigate deductions like mortgage interest, property taxes, and more. Check out this helpful blog article: https://lib.tax/3Si42nU
Do you owe taxes every year to the IRS? We’re still open to help you plan for the future and minimize your tax liability. You could even get a refund (for once)!

Tax Tips for Students: Keep track of your education-related expenses throughout the year. Expenses like tuition, textbooks, and student loan interest can lead to valuable tax deductions or credits when tax season rolls around. Check out our full guide here: https://lib.tax/436KwA0

Need to catch up on unfiled taxes? It’s never too late to get back on track! Liberty Tax can help you file back taxes up to 2021. If you owe, we’ll work with you to try and set up a payment plan and help you avoid penalties like wage garnishments. Contact us for more information: +1 802-257-2080

To claim a refund for your 2021 federal tax return, you must file by April 15, 2025 (or October 15, 2025, with a properly filed extension). Failure to file by the deadline may result in forfeiture of any refund due. Individual circumstances may vary. No refund is guaranteed.

Whether you’re catching up on past returns, planning for next year’s taxes, or finishing your extended taxes, Liberty Tax is here to make the process easier. We’ll help you identify tax credits you may qualify for like the Earned Income Tax Credit, Child Tax Credit, and Education Credits can directly increase your refund. Contact your local tax expert and make sure you’re not missing out: https://lib.tax/appointment

This Memorial Day, while you’re spending time with loved ones, don’t forget about your taxes. If you filed for an extension, now’s the time to wrap things up. Liberty Tax is here to help you file quickly and stress-free, so you can enjoy the day. Visit us today: https://www.libertytax.com/15560

Liberty Tax is open and here to help with whatever’s still on your tax to-do list. If you have questions about your extension, back taxes, or how to plan ahead for next year, we’ve got your back. https://www.libertytax.com/15560

Even after tax season, we’re still here—just like Mom. 💐
Whether you’re tying up loose ends or need help sorting something out, our tax experts are ready to support you. This Mother’s Day, take one more thing off your plate and let Liberty Tax help bring you peace of mind. #HappyMothersDay
